meta.purpose: English for the Sentence Builder. The Luxembourgish is never authored here — every key is a sentence that already exists, verbatim, either in the LOD example sentences or in content/hand-authored/model-answers.json. Only the English is written, which is what the corpus rule allows.
meta.keyedBy: the exact Luxembourgish sentence, so nothing depends on the order of any list
meta.topics: LOD tags an example sentence with every topic of every entry it illustrates, so one sentence arrives under topics it has nothing to do with. Where a sentence is LOD-sourced the topic recorded here is the one it was curated under, and the builder uses it.
meta.questionTopics: The tutor grouped the questions into seven sheets, not into the eighteen exam topics — so the book questions sat under media and the sport questions under hobbies. These re-file them where a learner would look.
